title: dashboards publishes no status file, so a pin on its action has no build to move to
foundBy: user choice (host), answering where a pin on the dashboards action should move: "dashboards publishes built"
details: Every project's `pages.yml` pins `codesweep-ai/dashboards/action` by commit, and a repin moves that pin like any other. The other projects publish a `ci-status.json` that lists the commits their CI built, and a pin moves only to one of those. This site publishes none, so a pin on the action has nothing to move to but main's tip, which may not have built.
